name: devstandard
description: DevStandard on Codex: the full development method - PRD/architecture/ADR lifecycle, issue -> branch/worktree -> PR -> two gated merge checks, and execution discipline. The session hook delivers core.md plus a bounded name-mappings page to every Codex session; collaboration with Claude Code sessions is by dispatch (a worker brief), never by harness identity. Install alongside the Claude Code DevStandard plugin or standalone.
